description: Public data needed by frozen/generate_signals.py. All URLs are public, free, need no key.
warmup_note: fetch_data.py downloads [floor_to_day(--start) - warmup_days, --end); generate_signals.py builds its minute grid from the same point, so every rolling window is complete.
layers: monthly zip -> daily zip -> REST with endTime (<=1500 rows/request); rows >= --end are never written

sources.name: index_1m
sources.description: Binance USD-M BTCUSDT index price, 1-minute klines (indexPriceKlines).

fields_used.open_time: kline open time, ms since epoch (UTC)
fields_used.close: index price at the end of the minute (used: P(t))

sources.public_at: A kline with open time t is complete and public at t + 60 s. generate_signals.py uses, for signal time T, only klines with open time <= T - 60 s.
sources.known_gaps_note: The first three gaps are the ones listed in the task. 2024-08-12 10:02-10:03 was missing from both the monthly and the daily archive during research; REST (fapi.binance.com) answered HTTP 451 from the research machine, so it could not be confirmed there. With REST reachable the REST layer is tried first.
